issues.description: The text 'Continue' and 'Delete' are rendered with very low contrast against their background buttons, making them difficult to read.
The text 'Diag' in the top left corner appears to be a placeholder or debug text that is not intended for the final user interface.
The layout is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space on the left side of the screen while content is centered and somewhat cramped, giving an unfinished appearance.
